item.title: How Trump's attacks on voting system integrity might affect upcoming elections
item.description: Election law expert Rick Hasen explains Trump's interference in the midterms, including threatening local officials with criminal prosecution unless they strike alleged noncitizens from voter rolls.

item.title: Why local officials are feeling 'on edge' as election day approaches
item.description: Al Schmidt is the chief election official in the state of Pennsylvania. President Trump's insults put him in danger during the 2020 ballot count. Now Schmidt talks about preparing for the midterms.

item.title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.

item.title: New human data hints at psychedelics' potential to combat inflammation
item.description: Lab studies have shown that psychedelics like psilocybin can lower inflammation and may be protective for a range of illnesses. Now, researchers are publishing some of the first data in humans that signals this holds potential for patients with neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson's disease.

item.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
item.description: The Justice Department's "likely" noncitizen voter list in California is "unreliable," according to officials. And, the United Nations reports a major increase in U.S. climate pollution.

item.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
item.description: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us
